findings.title: Pre-boot RCE in EDK II PXE driver (GHSA-99cj-7hg9-mp4m)
findings.summary_md: GitHub security advisory published 22 October 2026 discloses CVE-2026-97631, a buffer overflow in NetworkPkg/UefiPxeBcDxe. While PXE-booting over IPv4 or IPv6, an unauthenticated network attacker delivering ICMP error messages can corrupt DXE-phase memory and execute arbitrary pre-boot code. EDK II master as of 14 September 2026 is affected; no upstream patch is listed as current in the advisory.

findings.title: Fix ICMP buffer overflow in IPv4/IPv6 handle (CVE-2026-97631)
findings.summary_md: Pull request #13200 against tianocore/edk2 documents the root cause: incorrect buffer copy logic in ICMP error handling in the PXE-Base Code driver allowed large packets to write beyond the allocated buffer. The PR description explicitly names CVE-2026-97631 and ties it to the NetworkPkg/UefiPxeBcDxe component.
